items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: some of the sides done by Mel Powell on piano... the personnel were exactly the same

ctx.x: And then back with Goodman in '44 for the Seven Lively Arts Show, and this was '45, this period, still back after the show with the organization, and the new

sextet, as I said, was Slam and Mike Bryan, Red Norvo and some of the records that were recorded were with me on piano and somewhere - so there were the 78's, they still didn't have the LP's, it was 78's with some of the sides done by Mel Powell on piano. But otherwise, the personnel were exactly the same.
